name: openskill-galaxy-e2e
description: Five-tier regression suite for OpenSkill Galaxy

scripts.test:tier1: node --test tests/tier1/*.test.mjs && npx playwright test tests/tier1
scripts.test:tier2: node --test tests/tier2/*.test.mjs && npx playwright test tests/tier2
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:tier1 && npm run test:tier2 && npm run test:tier3 && npm run test:tier4 && npm run test:tier5
